title: YOU HAVE BEEN SERVED
tagline: A legal document server compliant with US and International Courts.
description:
We combined advances in hadera technology, with practical use of ENS - to align with mondern day needs of the legal and justice system.  

Around the world courts have adopted the use of Service by NFT and Web3 Wallet, but until today no tool had been made to serve this growing need.  

Now, law enforcement officers, legal professional, and courts can rely on our trusted system for services of process, summons, complaints and other practical uses of decentralized technologies.  Welcome to the YOU HAVE BEEN SERVED dapp!
how_its_made:
YOU HAVE BEEN SERVED -  is built on Next.js 15, Prisma + Neon, Clerk auth, and deployed on Vercel.

Hedera: Every service generates two on-chain artifacts — an HCS consensus message to topic 0.0.9225885 (immutable timestamped proof with case ref, defendant wallet, and agent address) and an HTS NFT minted and transferred to the defendant. Notable hack: HTS caps NFT metadata at 100 bytes, so instead of inline data we store a URL pointing to a live /api/nft/meta endpoint (~62 bytes) that returns full JSON with image, description, and typed attributes — HashScan fetches it and renders a proper certificate.

ENS: The process server agent is youhavebeenserved.eth (ENSIP-25). The key detail: our Hedera operator account's EVM address is the exact same ECDSA keypair as youhavebeenserved.eth on Ethereum mainnet — one key, provable identity across both chains. Recipients are addressed by ENS name with live resolution via viem.
auto_summary: A Next.js legal notice application records service events with ENS resolution, Hedera proofs, and wallet-based payment and identity flows.
